Those are the pictures that were sent to us by the Upside team via email. If you have not caused or done what is mentioned in the notice, we will inform the Upside team accordingly.

In the meantime, we kindly recommend that you pass by the reception and inform them as well, to avoid any potential fines or issues. Please note that this notice and any related fines are from the Upside team, not from our side.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
